messages:
Aisha (CS): Hey team — planning a small 'cookoff' for Verdant tomorrow to validate quota/cold-starts + autoscale thresholds. Can we do 10:00 PT?
Tom (SRE): 10:00 PT works for infra. I'll reserve the dedicated pool and pin model v2.1.
Nora (Acct Mgmt): fyi Verdant renewal in 6 weeks — want to surface any risk early. If the cookoff shows stability we can highlight SLA readiness. :thumbsup:
Ravi (ML Eng): Need to confirm model quantization profile is identical to prod. I'll push a verification artifact to the bucket.
Aisha (CS): Perfect. Runbook checklist (quick):
- quota allocation check
- autoscale policy review
- KMS access verified
- customer can replay shadow traffic
- post-run handoff notes
Tom (SRE): Adding runbook snippet below for load test runners:
```
# k6 runner example
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 15m loadscript.js 
# route traffic to dedicated pool with header: X-Redwood-Pool: verdant-dedicated
```
Nora (Acct Mgmt): Julian from Verdant, can you confirm a 10:00 PT check-in and whether you'll provide sample replay traffic or want us to generate synthetic?
Julian (Customer): We can provide a 30m window of replay from last week's peak — prefer 10. We'll share S3 link by EOD.
Loadbot: reserve:dpool:verdant-dedicated assigned -> pool-id: pd-42f7 (expires +6h)
Tom (SRE): Autoscale knobs I'm proposing: min_replicas=2, target_concurrency=120, cooldown=90s. These keep latency stable under 75th pct. Thoughts?
Ravi (ML Eng): Sounds good. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for repeated prompts — should cut token compute by ~18% in our profile.
Aisha (CS): Action items: Nora confirm renewal talking points if cookoff hits targets; Tom run test and post metrics to #eng-runtime; Ravi verify quant profile and enable caching; Julian share replay link. I'll host a 30m debrief after run.
Nora (Acct Mgmt): I'll draft a 1-pager with success/failure criteria for renewal conversation.
Tom (SRE): Quick failure-mode note — if we see OOM on p3dn, fallback policy will route to p2x with reduced concurrency, will post alert to #release-war-room.
Julian (Customer): Thanks all — we'll upload traffic and a short doc on expected behavior. See you 10:00 PT.
Aisha (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll shoot a calendar invite and attach the runbook. Post any preflight concerns here. :rocket:
